films.title: S.O.S.: Women to the Sea
films.overview: Recently divorced Adriana tries to get revenge on the woman who took her husband away from her by going on a European cruze along with them.

films.title: Teen's Confessions
films.overview: Four sisters work together to raise rent money after learning they have to move to another neighborhood in this coming-of-age drama based on the series.

films.title: S.O.S.: Women to the Sea 2
films.overview: Afraid her husband will fall back with his ex girlfriend after they're assigned to work together, Adriana and her sister set sail to the U.S. to go after him to stop this from happening.

films.title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
films.overview: Paula, a famous plastic surgeon, applies an experimental formula to herself that promises to completely eliminate cellulite. However, she ends up dying shortly after the test. Now, with the help of a medium, the doctor returns to Earth to try to stop her greedy ex-partner from putting the harmful product on the market.

films.title: Someone Borrowed
films.overview: To fulfill his mother’s dying wish and avoid being removed from her will, an inflexible bachelor hires an actress to play his fiancée.

films.title: It's a Fairy!
films.overview: Geraldine is a fairy who lost their wings by using unconventional methods in their missions. Her last chance to retrieve them will be the mission "Julia".

films.title: Sai de Baixo: O Filme
films.overview: Based on the classic Brazilian television series that conquered audiences during Sunday night prime time on TV Globo, with improv that happens like in scenes of a play. The feature film’s structure maintains the members of a middle-class family from São Paulo, their maid, and the building’s doorman. It’s the return of iconic characters like Caco Antibes, Magda and Ribamar, and also new characters.

films.title: Double Dad
films.overview: While her mom is away, a teen sneaks out of the hippie commune where she lives and embarks on a life-changing adventure to discover who her father is.
